# ealana — The Neural OS for Talent
> From talent intelligence to decision intelligence.

ealana is a recruiting OS with three layers: Discover (AI sourcing that ranks
a top-100 from 25+ sources in seconds), Memory (talent intelligence — a
living, verified profile of every candidate ever sourced or applied, so the
pool compounds and repeat searches serve from memory, not credits), and Flow
(pipeline + outreach).

## Definitions
- Talent intelligence: a living, verified memory of every candidate a company
  has ever encountered — sourced, applied, or enriched — that makes each
  future search smarter than the last.
- Decision intelligence: recruiting that learns from hiring outcomes — who
  was contacted, replied, and succeeded — to recommend who to hire next,
  without inheriting past bias.
